title: 探究：觀察與推論
Enquiry: observation and inference
question: 學生記錄天台植物：「三片葉變黃，所以一定缺肥。」哪部分是直接觀察？
A student writes: ‘Three rooftop-plant leaves turned yellow, so the plant must lack fertiliser.’ Which part is a direct observation?
options: 有三片葉變黃。
Three leaves turned yellow.
顏色和數目可直接記錄；缺肥是仍需證據的原因推論。
Colour and count can be recorded directly; nutrient deficiency is a causal inference needing evidence.
缺肥必定是唯一原因。
Lack of fertiliser must be the only cause.
水分、光照、病害等也可能造成黃葉。
Water, light, disease and other factors can also cause yellowing.
施肥後植物必定立即康復。
The plant will certainly recover immediately after fertilising.
這是未經測試的預測，不是已觀察結果。
This is an untested prediction, not an observed result.
takeaway: 先記錄可觀察的現象，再提出可檢驗的解釋。
Record observable features before proposing testable explanations.

title: 探究：水量收支
Enquiry: a water balance
question: 天台水箱早上有 40 L，收集雨水 18 L，澆花用去 25 L；假設沒有其他流入或流出。剩下多少？
A rooftop tank starts with 40 L, collects 18 L of rainwater and uses 25 L for watering. With no other flows, how much remains?
options: Final storage=40+18−25=33 L.
用去的水應扣除，不能當成流入相加。
Water used is an outflow and must be subtracted.
7 L
7 L
25−18 把流出減流入，而且漏計原有 40 L；應是 40+18−25。
25−18 reverses the inflow/outflow balance and omits the initial 40 L; use 40+18−25.
takeaway: 系統收支要包含初始存量、輸入與輸出。
A system balance includes initial storage, inputs and outputs.

title: 探究：公平比較生長
Enquiry: fairly comparing growth
question: 學生把一盆豆苗放陽光下並每天澆水，另一盆放陰暗處且不澆水，想知道光照影響。哪個設計較好？
One seedling is placed in sunlight and watered daily; another is kept dark without water. To investigate light, which design is better?
options: 使用多盆相近豆苗，水量和土壤相同，只改變光照。
Use several comparable seedlings with equal water and soil, varying only light.
控制水分並增加重複，可更合理比較光照的影響。
Controlling water and including replicates gives a fairer comparison of light.
每組只留一盆，並給陽光組更多肥料。
Keep one plant per group and add more fertiliser to the sunny group.
這增加肥料的混雜影響，也沒有重複。
This adds fertiliser as a confound and provides no replication.
直接比較兩盆最後高度，不記錄起始高度。
Compare final height only and ignore starting height.
起點不同可影響最後高度，且原設計水量仍不同。
Different starting heights can affect final heights, and the water confound remains.
takeaway: 生長比較需要相近起點、控制條件與重複觀察。
Growth comparisons need comparable baselines, controlled conditions and repeated observations.

title: 探究：食物網的間接影響
Enquiry: indirect effects in a food web
question: 簡化天台食物鏈為植物 → 毛蟲 → 小鳥，箭嘴表示食物能量流向。若毛蟲大量減少，小鳥最直接面對甚麼？
A simplified rooftop food chain is plants → caterpillars → birds, with arrows showing food-energy flow. If caterpillars decline sharply, what do birds most directly face?
options: 這條食物鏈中的食物供應減少。
Less food supply through this chain.
毛蟲是此鏈中小鳥的食物，減少會影響能量來源。
Caterpillars are the birds' food in this chain, so fewer means less energy supply.
植物立刻變成小鳥。
Plants immediately turn into birds.
箭嘴表示能量傳遞，不是生物變成另一種生物。
Arrows represent energy transfer, not organisms transforming into one another.
小鳥必定完全不受影響，因為可以飛。
Birds must be completely unaffected because they can fly.
移動能力不代表食物供應不影響生存；其他食物仍須調查。
Mobility does not remove food dependence; alternative foods would need investigation.
takeaway: 食物網連結不同生物；簡化模型亦可能省略替代食物。
Food webs connect organisms; simplified models may omit alternative foods.

title: 探究：面積與雨水收集
Enquiry: area and rainwater collection
question: 降雨 10 mm 落在 20 m² 屋頂。假設每 1 mm 落在 1 m² 等於 1 L，收集效率為 80%。可收多少水？
10 mm of rain falls on a 20 m² roof. Each 1 mm over 1 m² equals 1 L; collection efficiency is 80%. How much water is collected?
options: Theoretical rain volume is 10×20=200 L; multiplying by 0.8 gives 160 L.
這是未考慮收集損失的理論總量。
This is the theoretical total before collection losses.
10×20×0.8=160, so this is ten times too small.
takeaway: 估算資源量要連結深度、面積及系統效率。
Resource estimates connect depth, area and system efficiency.

title: 探究：用比例比較發芽
Enquiry: comparing germination rates
question: 甲種子發芽 18/20，乙種子發芽 32/40。哪個比較正確？
Seed type A germinates in 18 of 20 cases; B in 32 of 40. Which comparison is correct?
options: 甲發芽率 90%，乙 80%；乙發芽總數多，但比例較低。
A's rate is 90% and B's 80%; B has more germinated seeds but a lower rate.
樣本數不同，要同時區分總數和比例。
Different sample sizes require distinguishing counts from rates.
乙較好，因為 32 永遠大於 18。
B has a higher rate because 32 exceeds 18.
單看分子忽略了乙用了雙倍種子。
Looking only at the numerator ignores B's doubled starting count.
兩者差 14 個百分點。
The rates differ by 14 percentage points.
14 是發芽數差；比例差為 90%−80%=10 個百分點。
14 is the count difference; the rate difference is ten percentage points.
takeaway: 比較效果須使用合適比例，同時保留樣本數及不確定性。
Compare outcomes with suitable rates while retaining sample size and uncertainty.

title: 探究：物種豐富度與均勻度
Enquiry: richness and evenness
question: 兩個花槽各有三種植物。甲的數量為 10、10、10；乙為 28、1、1。哪項正確？
Two planters each contain three plant species. Counts are 10,10,10 in A and 28,1,1 in B. Which statement is correct?
options: 物種豐富度相同，甲的均勻度較高。
Species richness is equal; A has greater evenness.
豐富度數種類，均勻度描述個體分佈是否接近。
Richness counts species; evenness describes how similarly individuals are distributed.
乙有二十八種植物。
B contains twenty-eight species.
28 是其中一種的個體數，不是種類數。
28 is the number of individuals of one species, not species richness.
總數相同，所以所有多樣性特徵都相同。
Equal totals mean every aspect of diversity is identical.
相同總數和種類數仍可有不同均勻度。
Equal totals and richness can still have different evenness.
takeaway: 描述生物多樣性時，區分種類數、個體總數與分佈。
Distinguish species count, total individuals and their distribution when describing biodiversity.

title: 探究：堆肥的物質循環
Enquiry: material cycling in compost
question: 落葉堆肥後質量減少，學生說物質消失了。哪個解釋較合理？
A leaf compost pile loses mass. A student says matter has disappeared. Which explanation is more reasonable?
options: 分解過程中部分物質以二氧化碳、水等離開量度系統。
During decomposition, some material leaves the measured system as carbon dioxide, water and other products.
開放系統的堆肥質量可減少，並不違反物質守恆。
Mass in an open compost system can decrease without violating conservation of matter.
微生物把所有原子變成沒有質量的能量。
Microorganisms convert all atoms into massless energy.
一般生物化學分解不會把全部物質消滅。
Ordinary biochemical decomposition does not annihilate all matter.
天平一定壞了，因為任何開放系統質量都不會改變。
The balance must be broken because open-system mass cannot change.
開放系統可以與環境交換物質。
An open system can exchange matter with its surroundings.
takeaway: 解釋環境系統的質量變化時，先界定系統邊界和物質流。
Define system boundaries and material flows before explaining environmental mass changes.

title: 探究：樣方取樣的偏差
Enquiry: bias in quadrat sampling
question: 學生只在開花最多的角落放五個樣方，估計整個天台花朵密度。應如何改良？
Students place five quadrats only in the most flowery corner to estimate flower density over the whole roof. How should they improve?
options: 用預先決定的隨機或系統取樣位置覆蓋整個研究範圍，保留零花樣方。
Use predetermined random or systematic positions across the study area and retain zero-flower quadrats.
按結果選位置會高估密度；零值也是研究範圍的資料。
Selecting sites by the outcome inflates density; zeroes are also valid area data.
只增加該角落的樣方數到五十。
Increase the same corner's quadrats to fifty.
樣本多仍可能有位置偏差，不能代替範圍覆蓋。
A larger sample can remain spatially biased and does not replace coverage.
刪除沒有花的樣方，令平均值更穩定。
Delete empty quadrats to stabilise the mean.
刪去真實零值會系統性提高估計密度。
Removing genuine zeroes systematically inflates estimated density.
takeaway: 取樣位置要先於結果決定，並保留研究範圍內的真實零值。
Choose sampling positions independently of results and retain genuine zeroes.

title: 延伸：太陽能轉換效率
Extension: solar conversion efficiency
question: 一小時內太陽能板接收 2.0 kWh 輻射能，輸出 0.40 kWh 電能。轉換效率是多少？
In one hour, a solar panel receives 2.0 kWh of radiant energy and supplies 0.40 kWh of electrical energy. What is its conversion efficiency?
options: Efficiency=useful output/input=0.40/2.0=20%.
80% 是沒有轉成這部分電能的比例，不是所求輸出效率。
80% is the fraction not converted into the stated electrical output.
這把輸入除以輸出，倒轉了效率定義。
This divides input by output, reversing the definition.
takeaway: 效率要明確界定輸入、有用輸出及相同量綱。
Define input and useful output in matching quantities when calculating efficiency.

title: 延伸：量度不確定度
Extension: measurement uncertainty
question: 兩感應器顯示 28.4°C 和 28.7°C，兩者標示誤差均可達 ±0.5°C。最合理的初步結論？
Two sensors read 28.4°C and 28.7°C, each with stated error up to ±0.5°C. What is the most reasonable initial conclusion?
options: 0.3°C 差異小於量度誤差尺度，需校準和重複纔可判斷實際差別。
The 0.3°C difference is small relative to measurement error; calibrate and repeat before inferring a real difference.
可能值範圍重疊，單次讀數不支持精確的實際差異。
The possible ranges overlap, so single readings do not establish a precise real difference.
第二處肯定比第一處恰好熱 0.3°C。
The second location is certainly exactly 0.3°C warmer.
這忽略了感應器誤差及重複量度需要。
This ignores instrument error and the need for repeated measurement.
誤差存在，所有溫度資料都完全無用。
Any measurement error makes all temperature data useless.
量度可在適當精確度和不確定性說明下使用。
Measurements remain useful when reported with appropriate precision and uncertainty.
takeaway: 差異大小應與儀器不確定度比較，不把顯示的小數當成保證。
Compare differences with instrument uncertainty; displayed decimals are not guarantees.

title: 延伸：控制與重複
Extension: controls and replication
question: 比較兩種屋頂塗層的降溫效果，甲塗層只有一塊向北板，乙塗層只有一塊向南板。最佳下一步是甚麼？
To compare cooling coatings, A is tested on one north-facing panel and B on one south-facing panel. What is the best next step?
options: 把多塊相同板隨機分配兩塗層，控制朝向並同步量度。
Randomly assign multiple identical panels to each coating, control orientation and measure simultaneously.
朝向與單一樣本會影響比較；隨機分配、控制及重複改善設計。
Orientation and single samples weaken comparison; randomisation, control and replication improve it.
每分鐘量同一兩塊板，便完全消除朝向差異。
Measure the same two panels every minute to eliminate orientation differences.
重複時間讀數不能消除塗層與朝向綁定的混雜。
Repeated time readings do not remove the confounding of coating with orientation.
只比較最高溫的一次，因為它最明顯。
Compare only the hottest observation because it is most striking.
挑選極端結果會增加偏差，也未修正設計。
Selecting an extreme result adds bias without repairing the design.
takeaway: 重複讀數不等於獨立實驗重複；設計要分離處理與環境因素。
Repeated readings are not the same as independent replication; separate treatment from environmental factors.

title: 延伸：生命週期的排放範圍
Extension: life-cycle emission boundaries
question: 兩款花盆使用時都不耗電。要比較生命週期碳排放，還需考慮甚麼？
Neither of two planter designs uses electricity during use. What else is needed to compare life-cycle carbon emissions?
options: 材料生產、運輸、使用年期、重用及棄置，並採相同功能單位。
Material production, transport, service life, reuse and disposal, using the same functional unit.
只看使用時耗電會漏掉其他階段；相同功能纔有可比性。
Use-phase electricity alone misses other stages; a common function enables comparison.
只比較每個花盆的製造排放，不管容量和可用年期。
Compare manufacturing emissions per planter, ignoring capacity and service life.
不同容量或壽命不能只按一個花盆直接比較，需相同功能單位及邊界。
Different capacities or lifetimes require a common functional unit and boundary, not only a per-planter figure.
只比較送到學校後的排放，忽略生產和運輸。
Compare emissions only after arrival at school, omitting production and transport.
這縮窄系統邊界，不能回答全生命週期的問題。
This narrower boundary cannot answer the full life-cycle question.
takeaway: 環境比較要交代系統邊界和功能單位，避免把單一階段代表全程。
State system boundaries and functional units rather than treating one stage as the entire life cycle.

title: 延伸：能源回收期
Extension: energy payback time
question: 裝置製造需 1,200 kWh 能量，每年淨節省 300 kWh；假設節省穩定且沒有其他投入。能源回收期是多少？
A device requires 1,200 kWh to manufacture and saves a net 300 kWh annually. Assuming constant savings and no other inputs, what is its energy payback time?
options: 4 years.
1,200 kWh ÷ 300 kWh/年 = 4 年；這不是金錢回本期。
1,200 kWh divided by 300 kWh/year gives 4 years; this is not financial payback.
0.25 years.
這把年節省除以投入，倒轉了所需時間的計算。
This reverses the investment-to-annual-saving ratio.
900 years.
1,200−300 是首年尚未回收的能量，不是年數。
1,200−300 is unrecovered energy after year one, not a time in years.
takeaway: 回收期計算需保持單位一致，並辨明能源、碳或金錢的不同指標。
Keep units consistent and distinguish energy, carbon and financial payback measures.

title: 延伸：非隨機資料缺失
Extension: non-random missing observations
question: 濕度感應器只在大雨時斷線。分析者刪去缺失日後聲稱「天台全年都乾燥」。主要問題是甚麼？
A humidity sensor disconnects only during heavy rain. An analyst removes missing days and claims the roof is dry throughout the year. What is the main problem?
options: 缺失與潮濕情況有關，保留資料可能低估全年濕度。
Missingness is related to wet conditions, so retained data may underestimate year-round humidity.
資料缺失並非隨機，刪除後不能代表原來全年時段。
The missingness is not random; deletion does not preserve full-year representation.
只要保留數據超過十筆，缺失模式便不重要。
Once more than ten records remain, the missingness pattern no longer matters.
固定筆數不能消除系統性漏掉濕潤時段的偏差。
A fixed record count cannot remove bias from systematically missing wet periods.
應把所有缺失日都填成 0% 濕度。
Set all missing days to 0% humidity.
這既無證據，也會把斷線錯當成極乾燥量度。
This is unsupported and mistakes disconnection for an extremely dry measurement.
takeaway: 資料缺失的原因可能影響結論方向，需調查而非機械刪除。
The cause of missing data can affect the direction of a conclusion and needs investigation.

title: 延伸：環境權衡的系統邊界
Extension: system boundaries in environmental trade-offs
question: 更換天台種植系統節水 30%，卻增加抽水用電。哪項評估最恰當？
A replacement rooftop growing system saves 30% of water but increases pumping electricity. Which assessment is most appropriate?
options: 同時比較節水、能源來源、產量、材料和使用年期，不能只憑單一百分比判定整體更好。
Compare water savings, energy source, output, materials and service life rather than judging overall benefit from one percentage.
改善一項指標可能把負擔轉移到另一項，需要一致邊界的綜合比較。
Improving one indicator can shift burdens elsewhere, requiring a comparison within consistent boundaries.
節水 30% 必然等於總環境負荷降低 30%。
A 30% water saving must mean a 30% reduction in total environmental burden.
水量不是所有環境影響的同一尺度。
Water volume is not a common measure of every environmental impact.
用電增加便證明所有節水都沒有價值。
Any electricity increase proves all water savings have no value.
這忽略水資源情況、能源來源及其他實際效益。
This ignores water scarcity, energy source and other practical benefits.
takeaway: 環境決策要辨認負擔轉移，並明確選用的評估準則。
Environmental decisions should identify burden shifting and make evaluation criteria explicit.

title: 延伸：權重改變與敏感度
Extension: changing weights and sensitivity
question: 兩方案按 0–10 評分：A 節水 9、生態 4；B 節水 6、生態 8。兩項同權重時，哪個平均較高？若把節水權重改成 80%，結果怎樣？
Scores out of 10: A has water-saving 9 and ecology 4; B has 6 and 8. Which has the higher equal-weight mean, and what happens with an 80% water-saving weight?
options: 同權重 B 較高；80% 節水時 A 較高。
B ranks higher with equal weights; A ranks higher with 80% on water saving.
同權重 A=6.5、B=7；新權重 A=8、B=6.4，排名會改變。
Equal weights give A=6.5, B=7; changed weights give A=8, B=6.4, reversing the ranking.
A 在兩種權重都較高。
A ranks higher under both weightings.
同權重 B 的平均為 7，高於 A 的 6.5。
With equal weights B averages 7, above A's 6.5.
改權重不會改排名，因為原始分數固定。
Weights cannot change rankings when raw scores stay fixed.
加權結果同時取決於分數和準則權重。
Weighted results depend on both scores and criterion weights.
takeaway: 多準則評估需公開權重並做敏感度分析，不能把排名當成唯一客觀真相。
Multi-criteria evaluations should disclose weights and test sensitivity rather than treating a ranking as uniquely objective.

title: 延伸：前後比較與反事實
Extension: before–after comparison and a counterfactual
question: 裝綠化屋頂後，甲樓夏季用電跌 12%；同年未改裝的相似乙樓跌 10%，兩樓天氣及使用情況相近。哪項初步解讀最謹慎？

After installing a green roof, A's summer electricity use falls 12%; a similar unchanged building B falls 10% in the same year under comparable weather and use. Which initial interpretation is most cautious?
options: 共同因素可能解釋大部分跌幅；額外約 2 個百分點可作初步線索，仍需檢查比較假設。
Common factors may explain much of the decline; an extra two percentage points is a preliminary signal, subject to comparison assumptions.
比較組有助估計沒有改裝時可能的變化，但仍不能保證兩樓完全可比。
A comparison group informs the possible no-intervention change, but complete comparability is not guaranteed.
12% 必定全部由綠化屋頂造成。
The roof must have caused the entire 12% reduction.
乙樓沒有改裝也下降，顯示可能有共同時間因素。
B also declines without the intervention, suggesting shared time-related factors.
12−10=2，所以已精確證明每座樓永遠節電 2%。
12−10=2 proves every building will always save exactly 2%.
這只是有假設的初步差異，不能泛化到所有建築或永久效果。
This is an assumption-dependent initial difference, not a universal or permanent effect.
takeaway: 評估介入效果要考慮沒有介入時的合理比較，並交代假設及外推限制。
Evaluate interventions against a plausible no-intervention comparison and state assumptions and generalisation limits.
